stem:
Propanone, $\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3$, reacts with iodine, $\text{I}_2$, in the presence of an acid catalyst.

$$\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3 + \text{I}_2 \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_2\text{I} + \text{H}^+ + \text{I}^-$$

The rate equation for this reaction is shown.

$$\text{rate} = k[\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3][\text{H}^+]$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Complete Table 1.1 to describe the order of the reaction.

Table 1.1

|  |  |
| :--- | :--- |
| order of the reaction with respect to $[\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3]$ |  |
| order of the reaction with respect to $[\text{I}_2]$ |  |
| order of the reaction with respect to $[\text{H}^+]$ |  |
| overall order of the reaction |  |

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: An experiment is performed using a large excess of $\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3$ and a large excess of $\text{H}^+\text{(aq)}$. The initial concentration of $\text{I}_2$ is $1.00 \times 10^{-5} \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$. The initial rate of decrease in the $\text{I}_2$ concentration is $2.27 \times 10^{-7} \text{ mol dm}^{-3} \text{ s}^{-1}$.
parts.text:
Use the axes to draw a graph of $[\text{I}_2]$ against time for the first 10 seconds of the reaction.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State whether it is possible to calculate the numerical value of the rate constant, $k$, for this reaction from your graph. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The experiment is repeated at a different temperature. The initial concentrations of $\text{H}^+$ ions, $\text{I}_2$ and $\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3$ are all $0.200 \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$.

The value of $k$ at this temperature is $2.31 \times 10^{-5} \text{ mol}^{-1} \text{dm}^3 \text{ s}^{-1}$.

Calculate the initial rate of this reaction.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem:
The experiment is repeated using an excess of $\text{H}^+\text{(aq)}$. The new rate equation is shown.

$$\text{rate} = k_1[\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3]$$

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: The value of $k_1$ is $1.1 \times 10^{-3} \text{s}^{-1}$. Calculate the value of the half-life, $t_{\frac{1}{2}}$.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text:
Use your answer to (i) to draw a graph of $[\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3]$ against time for this reaction. The initial value of $[\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3]$ on your graph should be $0.200 \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$. The final value of $[\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3]$ on your graph should be $0.0250 \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}

parts.label: (e)
parts.stem:
A four-step mechanism is suggested for the overall reaction.

$$\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3 + \text{I}_2 \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_2\text{I} + \text{H}^+ + \text{I}^- \text{          rate} = k[\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3][\text{H}^+]$$

Part of this mechanism is shown.

step 1: $\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3 + \text{H}^+ \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{C}^+\text{(OH)CH}_3$

step 2: $\text{CH}_3\text{C}^+\text{(OH)CH}_3 \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{C(OH)=CH}_2 + \text{H}^+$

step 3: $\ldots\ldots \rightarrow \ldots\ldots$

step 4: $\text{CH}_3\text{C}^+\text{(OH)CH}_2\text{I} \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_2\text{I} + \text{H}^+$

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest the slowest step of the mechanism. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (e)(iii)
parts.text: Identify one conjugate acid-conjugate base pair in the mechanism.
